title: Omgång 12 · prov · kaffe ur Scout Gaming-koppen · Kling 4
summary: Gör en vilofilm av Paow: hon sitter still, och filmen börjar och slutar på ankare 1.

step.label: Vila, samma bild först och sist

prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. She starts and ends exactly as in the first frame, and holds still for the last half second. Her eyes go down as she bends a little to her right, and her right hand, at the left of the picture, reaches down below the edge of the table, out of sight, and comes back up holding a white coffee mug with the words "Scout Gaming" printed in black on the side facing the camera. She bends her head a little to the mug and takes one small sip, then straightens up, and her hand takes the mug back down below the edge of the table and comes back to rest on the felt where it lay. Her eyes come back up to the camera. Her other hand rests on the felt.
